title: 第5350章 制造机会第5349章 准备不足
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：陆沉周若雪第5350章制造机会（..la）骨族防区，在一座高大的哨所里面，一群骨族高层正在气炸天。
他们派去的百万大军，差点就被人族给干完了，损失可谓是极之惨重。
就算抵御外敌十年，一共所遭受的损失也没有这么多，人族简直可恶之极。
最可恨的，还是那个九龙传人陆沉，正是他唆教了人族大军对骨族大军下的毒手，而且是赶尽杀绝的那种。
还有，率领百万大军的那个骨族高层，本来就是他们的同僚，现在回不来了，已经死在了陆沉的拳下。
“此仇不报，非骨子！”
“有仇必报，才是我们骨族的性格，必须把场子给捞回来，不然我们骨族难以抬头，以后在曙光哨所还怎么混？”
“我们一共派出去一百一十万人，只逃回来二十多万，还有八十多万回不来了，这个损失不找人族要，还能找谁要？”
“这笔血账必须计算清楚，人族杀了我们那么多人，我们也要杀人族更多人，否则无法向底下的人交待。”
“血债血还，还是立即就还，我们应该立即起兵，给人族来一发袭击，让人族付出至少同样多的代价。”
“那还等什么，马上召集所有兵力，今天就去把人族揍一顿，不要拖延时间了，否则我们就是在吃哑巴亏。”
一众骨族高层怒火冲天，个个喊打喊杀，均想要即时出兵报仇。
但是，如此大的事情，还轮不到他们作主，他们不是骨族虚神的一把手。
只有他们的领头枯石，才是骨族虚神的一把手，一切大事决策权，只有枯石说了算。
此时此刻，枯石脸上也有愠怒之色，却在看着一众骨族高层的愤怒发言，愣是什么话都没说。
为了替魔族斩杀陆沉，骨族损失了大批兵力，还没能把任务给完成，真是失败透顶了。
他心情已经坏到极点，只是没有爆发出来而已，也不好意思爆发。
他作为骨族虚神的领头，就是他派遣大量部队追杀陆沉，如今行动失败了，他是要为此负责的。
只不过，在曙光哨所这一块，他是最大的骨族高层，再无更高级的上司惩罚他而已。
但是，魔族那边收到骨族战败的消息，已经传音过来把他骂个狗血淋头了，

“头，你就这样一直看着我们，怎么不说话？”
“头，我们说了那么多，你好歹也有一个表态啊。”
“头，人族杀了我们八十多万人，我们骨族什么时侯吃过这么大的亏，此仇不能不报啊。”
“头，只要你一声令下，我们立即召集千万大军，把那支人族大军杀个片甲不留！”
“头，你在想什么呢，我们在等你的话呢，只有你才有权下达征战令。”
一众骨族高层见枯石一言不发，便纷纷开口催促。
过了半晌，枯石才叹了一口气，冷冷的扫了一眼骨族高层们，然后才开口问道：“你们的牢骚发完了？”
“发……发完了。”
一个骨族高层有点结巴的回应。
“发完了，那就别再发了，然后轮到我说几句了。”
枯石皱了皱眉头，又如此说道，“这一次是我们太大意了，没想到人族早有庇护陆沉准备，连最偏僻的地方都布置了眼线，而我们出兵计划又不够谨慎，不吃大亏就有鬼了。”
顿了顿，他接着说道，“人族的实力比我们强，准备也比我们做得足，我们就算再派更多部队过去，也未必报得了仇！”
“头，你的意思是，我们派多少我去报仇，人族那边也会相应增加多少兵力咯？”
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Lu Chen and Zhou Ruoxue Chapter 5350: Creating Opportunities (..la) In the Bone Clan Defense Zone, in a tall outpost, a group of Bone Clan senior executives were furious.
The millions of troops they sent were almost killed by the human race, and the losses were extremely heavy.
Even if they resisted foreign enemies for ten years, the total losses they suffered would not be so much. The human race was simply abominable.
The most hateful thing was Lu Chen, the descendant of the Nine Dragons. It was he who instigated the human army to attack the Bone Clan army and killed them all.
Also, the senior Bone Clan leader who led a million-strong army was originally their colleague, but now he cannot come back and has died under Lu Chen's fist.
"If you don't avenge this revenge, it's not your bones!"
"It is the character of our Bone Clan to retaliate when we have a grudge. We must regain our position, otherwise our Bone Clan will not be able to raise our heads. How can we still hang out at Dawn Outpost in the future?"
"We sent out a total of 1.1 million people, but only more than 200,000 escaped, and more than 800,000 will never come back. If we don't ask for this loss from the human race, who else can we ask for it from?"
"This bloody account must be calculated clearly. The human race has killed so many of us, and we have to kill more people, otherwise we will not be able to explain to the people below."
"Should blood debt be repaid with blood immediately? We should immediately raise troops and attack the human race, making the human race pay at least the same price."
"Then what are you waiting for? Call all the troops immediately and go and beat up the human race today. Don't delay any longer, otherwise we will suffer the consequences of being dumb."
The high-ranking officials of the Bone Clan were furious, shouting to fight and kill, and all wanted to send troops to take revenge immediately.
However, it is not their turn to make the decision on such a big matter. They are not the top leaders of the Bone Clan's False God.
Only their leader Ku Shi is the leader of the Bone Clan's False God, and only Ku Shi has the final say on all major decisions.
At this moment, Ku Shi also had a sullen look on his face, but he was stunned and said nothing as he watched the angry speeches of the senior Bone Clan executives.
In order to kill Lu Chen for the demon clan, the Bone Clan lost a large number of troops, and they were still unable to complete the task. It was a complete failure.
His mood was extremely bad, but he just didn't break out, and he was too embarrassed to break out.
As the leader of the Bone Clan's False God, he sent a large number of troops to hunt down Lu Chen. Now that the operation failed, he is responsible for it.
However, at Dawn Outpost, he is the largest senior member of the Bone Clan, and there is no higher-level superior to punish him.
However, the Demon Clan received the news of the Bone Clan's defeat and sent a message to him to scold him bloody.
"Tou, you keep looking at us like this, why don't you say anything?"
"Boss, we have talked so much, at least you have a statement."
"Boss, the human race has killed more than 800,000 of us. When have our Bone Race ever suffered such a big loss? We must avenge this."
"Boss, as long as you give the order, we will immediately summon an army of tens of millions and kill the human army without leaving any trace behind!"
"Boss, what are you thinking about? We are waiting for your words. Only you have the authority to issue battle orders."
Seeing that Ku Shi didn't say a word, a group of senior Bone Clan officials began to urge him.
After a long while, Ku Shi sighed, glanced coldly at the senior Bone Clan executives, and then asked: "Are you done with your complaints?"
"I've sent it... I've finished it."
A high-ranking member of the Bone Clan stuttered in response.
"After you've sent it, don't send it anymore. Then it's my turn to say a few words."
Ku Shi frowned and said, "We were too careless this time. I didn't expect that the human race had already prepared to protect Lu Chen, and even placed spies in the most remote places. And our troop dispatch plan was not careful enough. If we don't suffer a big loss, we will be in trouble."
After a pause, he continued, "The human race is stronger than us and better prepared than us. Even if we send more troops,Even if the team goes over, they may not get their revenge! "
"Boss, what do you mean, how many troops we send to me to take revenge, will the human race increase its troops accordingly? "
